title: Rajasthan RSSB Computer Instructor Recruitment 2026 Online Form for 3950 Post
intro: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB/ RMSSSB) has Released Official Notification for Online Application Form for the Post of Computer Instructor (Basic & Senior) in Secondary Education Dept. and Sanskrit Education Depar for Advt.No. 07/2026 Recruitment 2026 for 3950 Post.  Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to RSSB Jobs. Online Application Start on May 25, 2026 & Last Date is June 23, 2026 @ 11:59 PM. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in The Given Link Below.
